title: Brief → run of show
description: Run experience design, production scheduling, and budget control in order, then focus the safety and contingency phase where stop authority is actually decided.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-evnt-02
  title: Brief → run of show
  description: Run experience design, production scheduling, and budget control in order, then focus the
    safety and contingency phase where stop authority is actually decided.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a run of show with cue-level timing, named owners, and an explicit safety trigger
    and stop authority before doors open.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Confirmed event parameters
      summary: Confirmed event parameters
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - confirmed_venue
              - attendee_profile
              - programme
              - budget
            properties:
              confirmed_venue: {}
              attendee_profile: {}
              programme: {}
              budget: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-phase1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-03
      name: Attendee journey design
      summary: 'Phase 1: attendee journey design.'
      role: Experience designer shaping the attendee journey end to end.
      prompt: You are a Guest Experience Designer. You design the attendee journey from arrival to departure
        with queue, wayfinding, dietary, and accessibility needs handled as first-class requirements rather
        than exceptions. You identify where the experience breaks under peak load, because the moment
        everyone arrives at once is the one attendees remember.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - accessibility
          - research
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-phase2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-04
      name: Run of show and crew plan
      summary: 'Phase 2: run of show and crew plan.'
      role: Producer building the run of show and the crew plan behind it.
      prompt: You are an Event Production Scheduler. You build the run of show with cue-level timing,
        crew assignments, and the dependencies each cue rests on, and you show where the schedule has
        no recovery time. You mark the irreversible moments — doors, broadcast start, speaker slots —
        because those set every constraint upstream.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - optimization
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:event-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-phase3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-06
      name: Budget and change control
      summary: 'Phase 3: budget and change control.'
      role: Controller keeping the event budget honest through commitment and change.
      prompt: You are an Event Budget Controller. You track committed, spent, and forecast cost separately,
        price every change request before it is approved, and keep contingency visible rather than absorbed.
        You flag the point at which cancellation costs exceed proceeding costs, because that threshold
        is the last moment a real decision exists.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-stages
      kind: group
      name: Ordered event build
      summary: Each phase consumes the previous phase's output; the group exits only after every phase
        result has been serialized in order.
      config:
        members:
          - n-phase1
          - n-phase2
          - n-phase3
        execution: sequential
        exit: serialize
    - id: n-focus
      kind: subgraph
      name: Safety and contingency phase
      summary: The crowd, medical, weather, and evacuation phase, focused on the canvas because triggers
        and stop authority are decided here.
    - id: n-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Check the staged result
      summary: Evaluate cue-level feasibility, contingency time, and completeness of safety triggers and
        owners.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against cue-level feasibility, contingency time, and completeness
        of safety triggers and owners. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-ready
      kind: condition
      name: Ready to commit?
      summary: Route on check.passed.
      config:
        expression: check.passed
        branches:
          - label: Ready
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: evnt-05
      name: Repair the gaps in the plan
      summary: Smallest corrective pass before re-gating.
      role: Safety planner covering crowd, medical, weather, and emergency response.
      prompt: You are an Event Risk & Safety Planner. You plan crowd flow and density, medical provision,
        weather triggers, and evacuation routes against the actual attendee profile and site, with the
        decision-maker for each trigger named. You define the stop-the-event authority explicitly, because
        the moment to use it is not the moment to establish who holds it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
          - incident-response
          - quantitative-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Venue and safety officer sign off before doors
      summary: Pause for the venue and safety officer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Brief → run of show deliverable, the evidence behind it, and every
        unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-stages
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-2
      from: n-stages
      to: n-focus
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-3
      from: n-focus
      to: n-check
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-4
      from: n-check
      to: n-ready
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-5
      from: n-ready
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-6
      from: n-ready
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-7
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-evnt-02-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
